claims.statement: Entitlement cache version mismatch: app using version 41 while directory holds version 42 for affected users
claims.corroboration: Traces confirmed version 41 vs 42 mismatch; eviction proved cache refresh resolves the failures (31% → 1% success rate in 3 minutes)
claims.limitation: Root cause confirms mechanism but does not explain why automatic cache refresh failed after directory sync

claims.statement: Authorization failures decreased from 31% to 1% following entitlement cache eviction
claims.corroboration: Verified tier-1 observability data; outcome within 3 minutes
claims.limitation: Remaining 1% may reflect unrelated authorization issues or slow cache propagation

claims.statement: Root cause fully mitigated and reversibility confirmed
claims.corroboration: Eviction result explicitly states 'reversible'; impact (C8) proves fix works
claims.limitation: Does not address underlying cause of cache refresh failure; does not prevent recurrence

capability_gaps.capability: Root cause of cache refresh failure
capability_gaps.reason: Cannot determine if release r7 dependencies broke automatic refresh, if refresh is disabled, or if it never triggered; requires service code review or dependency audit

next_action.rationale: Incident assessment complete. Root cause established: stale entitlement cache (version 41 vs directory version 42) caused 31% authorization failures for 214 users with overnight role changes. Mitigation (cache eviction) approved by human gate and successfully executed; failures reduced to 1% within 3 minutes. All authorized diagnostics performed; no further action available within incident authority.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Assessment closed. Root cause: stale_authz_cache. Status: mitigated and reversible. Recommendations for follow-up: investigate why automatic cache refresh failed after directory sync (likely release r7 dependency impact); implement version-mismatch alerting to detect similar incidents faster.
